columns.description: First day of the calendar year the observation describes.
columns.name: period

columns.description: Nomenclature level of the branch: A10, A38 or A88.
columns.name: level

columns.description: INSEE code of the branch within its level (A10 and A38 letters, A88 two-digit NACE division); a residual row joins the codes it covers with '+'.
columns.name: branch_code

columns.description: Provider's English name of the branch, from the INSEE codelist; a residual row joins the names it covers with '; '.
columns.name: branch_label

columns.description: Code of the branch one level up: the A10 branch of an A38 branch, the A38 branch of an A88 industry; null at A10.
columns.name: parent_code

columns.description: Code of the A10 branch the row belongs to.
columns.name: a10_code

columns.description: Code of the A38 branch the row belongs to; null at A10.
columns.name: a38_code

columns.description: True for an A88 row derived as its A38 parent less the industries INSEE publishes separately.
columns.name: is_residual

columns.description: Gross value added at current prices, millions of euros.
columns.name: value_added_current_eur_mn

columns.description: Gross value added in chained volumes at 2020 prices, millions of euros; null on residual rows.
columns.name: value_added_chained_2020_eur_mn

columns.description: Value added at current prices as a percentage of total value added of all branches in the same year.
columns.name: share_of_total_value_added_pct

indicators.attribution: Source: INSEE, comptes nationaux annuels, base 2020.
indicators.definition: Gross value added of the branch at current prices (CNA-2020-CPEB, OPERATION=B1G, PRIX_REF=VAL), taken from the provider series INSEE maintains for the branch; on residual rows, the A38 parent's value less that of its published A88 industries.
indicators.source: INSEE BDM, annual national accounts base 2020, production accounts by branch

indicators.attribution: Source: INSEE, comptes nationaux annuels, base 2020.
indicators.definition: Gross value added of the branch in chained volumes referenced to 2020 (OPERATION=B1G, PRIX_REF=PCH), from the maintained provider series. Chained volumes do not add across branches.
indicators.source: INSEE BDM, annual national accounts base 2020, production accounts by branch

indicators.attribution: Source: INSEE, comptes nationaux annuels, base 2020.
indicators.definition: 100 * value_added_current_eur_mn / total value added of all branches (NNTOTAL, OPERATION=B1G, PRIX_REF=VAL) in the same year.
indicators.source: Derived in this package from INSEE production accounts by branch
indicators.unit: Per cent of total value added

model.description: One row per year and branch of French gross value added at three nested levels of INSEE's nomenclature of activities (A10, A38, A88), at current prices, in chained 2020 volumes and as a share of total value added, each level published only for years in which all its branches are.
model.name: french_branch_value_added

questions.derivation: Select each branch's value added and its share of total value added at one level; the branches one level down from a branch are those whose parent_code is its branch_code.
questions.question: How is value added distributed across branches of activity, and how has that distribution shifted, from broad sectors down to individual industries?

questions.derivation: Select each branch's value added in chained 2020 volumes by year; its ratio between two years is the branch's volume growth.
questions.question: How has each branch's value added grown in volume?

temporal.meaning: Each period is the first day of the calendar year whose value added the row carries.

validations.description: Each branch appears once per year at its level.
validations.name: one_row_per_branch_and_year

validations.description: Shares at each level add up to 100 within rounding.
validations.name: each_level_adds_up_to_total_value_added

validations.description: A38 branches add up to their A10 parent and A88 industries, residual included, to their A38 parent, at current prices.
validations.name: children_add_up_to_their_parent

validations.description: Every series INSEE maintains for a published branch carries the published value for each year the branch is published at the copy's level.
validations.name: maintained_copies_of_a_branch_agree

validations.description: Every branch code the provider publishes value added under is declared in the package nomenclature.
validations.name: every_provider_branch_code_is_declared

validations.description: A10 and A38 reach the latest year of total value added and A88 the latest year every maintained industry reaches.
validations.name: every_level_reaches_the_latest_detailed_year

validations.description: Shares of total value added lie between -1 and 100.
validations.name: within_range
